Path.description: Type and UIA segments must be alone. Serialized paths must not exceed 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

Value.description: For truncated values truncatedAt is greater than the Unicode scalar length of scalar; dependencySource is present only for dependency reads.

MemberPage.description: nextToken is present iff further items exist; incomplete pages may instead indicate partial failure.

ManagedNodePage.description: nextToken is present iff further items exist; incomplete pages may instead indicate partial failure.

BindingInfo.description: Recursive binding trees have maximum depth 8 and 32 total entries.

Scalar.description: Numbers must be finite; writes require exact scalar CLR types and signed 64-bit integer tokens; no conversions or nulls.

Scope.description: Depth-first pre-order; scoped roots are depth 0; combined visits visual before logical-only children and deduplicates identity.

Predicate.description: Validate the shared regex subset and bounds before matching; Python re.search semantics with ASCII-only case folding, multiline anchors and singleline dot; reject unsupported constructs and malformed patterns. Equality is type-aware; assignability uses already-loaded metadata. Unavailable, redacted, truncated or failed values cannot silently match.

Locator.description: Predicates are ANDed; index selects after filtering. Defaults are applied before serialization.

Rect.description: Physical screen pixels; all numbers finite.

ElementState.description: Snapshot of physical geometry and all named applied-template parts; null geometry is unusable. Values must be finite; visibility includes clipping and viewport.

ItemMatch.description: Validate the shared regex subset and bounds before matching; Python re.search semantics with ASCII-only case folding, multiline anchors and singleline dot; reject unsupported constructs and malformed patterns.

ItemSearch.description: Enumerate item data in Items order without realizing candidates; select first match.

MatchWarning.description: Count observed within budget, potentially a lower bound.

WriteAudit.description: Never include values; redacted identifiers use the applicable rule. Deadline failures are audited immediately with reason timeout.

AllowEntry.description: Exact runtime type and public instance member; method keys specify exact CLR parameter types with no whitespace.

EventsEventParams.description: Ordered per subscription; sequence gaps, overflow and reconnect require rescan. Buffer at most 1024; overflow drops pending and triggering events.

QueryFindAllResult.description: Count only after full traversal; incomplete results may be capped or budget-limited.

HitTestParams.description: Point is in physical screen pixels; HWND must be a live WPF HwndSource of the target process.
